shah_shahidan_to_dorfak.title: شاه‌شهیدان تا قلهٔ درفک
shah_shahidan_to_dorfak.subtitle: مسیر شرقی درفک از شاه‌شهیدان، تیرهای برق و چشمه تا قله

notes: The 2014 GPX reaches the summit waypoint at approximately 14.43 km; its timestamp ordering is not usable for moving-time.
The 2024 independent GPX is a round-trip cross-check and is not used as a one-way timing source.
GPX elevation is reference evidence; catalog weather elevations use Open-Meteo GLO-90 DEM with waypoint cross-check.

shirkuh_to_dorfak.title: شیرکوه تا قلهٔ درفک
shirkuh_to_dorfak.subtitle: مسیر غربی درفک از شیرکوه، لارنه و جیرونی تا قله

notes: The full 2017 GPX runs from the Shirkuh mosque area to the summit area and reports approximately 15.84 km geometry.
The full-track timestamps are export-generated and are used for geometry only; the shorter independent track is a route cross-check.
GPX elevation is reference evidence; catalog weather elevations use Open-Meteo GLO-90 DEM with waypoint cross-check.

estakhrgah_to_dorfak.title: استخرگاه تا قلهٔ درفک
estakhrgah_to_dorfak.subtitle: مسیر جنوبی جنگلی درفک از استخرگاه، چشمه و لبهٔ جنگل تا قله

notes: The source GPX and report are summit-to-Estakhrgah descent evidence; the route is displayed in the reverse direction as Estakhrgah-to-summit ascent.
The source track begins approximately 1 km from the canonical summit coordinate; the final summit point is catalog evidence and the route timing is provisional.
The generic source waypoint محل استراحت is intentionally excluded from public route points.
The source report describes one spring on the forest route; carry sufficient water.
